why: Searches confirm the equiconsistency of strongly compact and supercompact cardinals is still described as widely open, called the 'holy grail problem' of inner model theory; related recent work (PFA equiconsistency conjecture, strong compactness of omega_1 without AC) addresses adjacent questions, not this one.
